# Leora Behavioral Health

> > Comprehensive addiction and mental health treatment center in Ohio offering evidence-based programs from detoxification through outpatient care.

Leora Behavioral Health operates addiction treatment and mental health services across Ohio locations including Columbus and Dayton. The center specializes in integrated treatment for co-occurring disorders using evidence-based therapies and medication-assisted treatment.

## Key Topics

- Addiction Treatment
- Mental Health Treatment
- Medication-Assisted Treatment (MAT)
- Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
- Dialectical Behavioral Therapy (DBT)
- 12-Step Therapy
- Family Therapy
- Partial Hospitalization Program (PHP)
- Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP)
- Ambulatory Detoxification
- Co-Occurring Disorders
- Ohio Locations
- Behavioral Health
- Substance Use Disorder
- Recovery Support

- [Leora BH Addiction Treatment Center in Ohio](https://www.leorabh.com/programs/addiction-treatment-center-in-ohio): Primary addiction treatment program with comprehensive outpatient care in Ohio.
- [Partial Hospitalization Programs (PHP) In Ohio](https://www.leorabh.com/levels-of-care/partial-hospitalization-program-in-ohio): Intensive Partial Hospitalization Program for addiction and mental health.
- [Intensive Outpatient Programs (IOP) in Ohio](https://www.leorabh.com/levels-of-care/intensive-outpatient-program-in-ohio): Intensive Outpatient Program balancing treatment with daily life responsibilities.
- [Virtual IOP in Ohio | Leora Behavioral Health](https://www.leorabh.com/services/virtual-iop): Virtual intensive outpatient program offering flexible online addiction treatment.

## Treatment Services & Therapies

- [MAT Therapy in Ohio at Leora BH: Combining Medication & Behavioral Treatment](https://www.leorabh.com/services/mat-therapy-program-in-ohio): Medication-Assisted Treatment combining medication and behavioral therapy.
- [Ambulatory Detox In Ohio | Leora Behavioral Health](https://www.leorabh.com/services/ambulatory-detox-in-ohio): Expert ambulatory detoxification services providing safe, personalized care.
- [CBT Therapy in Ohio at Leora BH: Transforming Thought Patterns in Recovery](https://www.leorabh.com/services/cbt-therapy-program-in-ohio): Cognitive Behavioral Therapy treating addiction and mental health issues.
- [DBT Therapy at Leora BH: Building Coping Skills & Emotional Resilience](https://www.leorabh.com/services/dbt-therapy-in-ohio): Dialectical Behavior Therapy for managing emotions and building resilience.
- [12-Step Therapy in Ohio at Leora BH: Structured Addiction Recovery Path](https://www.leorabh.com/services/12-step-therapy-program-in-ohio): 12-Step Therapy program providing structured addiction recovery support.
- [Family Therapy in Ohio at Leora BH: Healing Relationships in Addiction Recovery](https://www.leorabh.com/services/family-therapy-program-in-ohio): Family therapy supporting healing and growth for families affected by addiction.
- [Leora BH Case Management in Ohio: Personalized Recovery Support](https://www.leorabh.com/services/case-management-in-ohio): Case management services coordinating treatment and recovery goals in Ohio.
